Daily temperatures at Melbourne Airport, 1970 to 2022

Source: R/data.R
melb_temp.Rd

Daily maximum and minimum air temperature recorded at the Melbourne Airport weather station (Bureau of Meteorology station 086282). Every calendar day from 1 January 1970 to 26 July 2022 has a row, so days without an observation appear as NA rather than being dropped. Readings that accumulate over more than one day were set to NA because they cannot be assigned to a single date.

Usage

melb_temp

Format

A data frame with one row per calendar day and 7 columns:

date

Calendar date (Date).

year

Calendar year (integer).

month

Calendar month, 1 (January) to 12 (December) (integer).

tmax

Daily maximum temperature in degrees Celsius; NA if not observed.

tmax_quality

Bureau of Meteorology quality flag for tmax: "Y" if quality controlled, "N" if not yet completely quality controlled; NA if there is no observation.

tmin

Daily minimum temperature in degrees Celsius, recorded over the 24 hours to 9am; NA if not observed.

tmin_quality

Quality flag for tmin, coded as for tmax_quality.

Source

Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Climate Data Online, http://www.bom.gov.au/climate/data/, products IDCJAC0010 (maximum temperature) and IDCJAC0011 (minimum temperature), station 086282. Copyright Commonwealth of Australia, Bureau of Meteorology. The data preparation script is in data-raw/melb_temp.R.

Examples

head(melb_temp)
#>         date year month tmax tmax_quality tmin tmin_quality
#> 1 1970-01-01 1970     1   NA         <NA>   NA         <NA>
#> 2 1970-01-02 1970     1   NA         <NA>   NA         <NA>
#> 3 1970-01-03 1970     1   NA         <NA>   NA         <NA>
#> 4 1970-01-04 1970     1   NA         <NA>   NA         <NA>
#> 5 1970-01-05 1970     1   NA         <NA>   NA         <NA>
#> 6 1970-01-06 1970     1   NA         <NA>   NA         <NA>
summary(melb_temp$tmax)
#>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.     NAs 
#>    5.70   14.80   18.60   19.87   23.60   46.80     188
